name: Manor Gardens Bandstand
summary: A Victorian bandstand set within the town gardens.
description: Manor Gardens is a Victorian-style, railed garden right in the centre of Exmouth, and its bandstand is one of the town's best-loved outdoor spots for an event. It is wired for power and lighting, which makes it a genuine option for an evening concert or open-air theatre, and it is a popular choice for wedding blessings. The surrounding gardens can also be booked exclusively if you want to charge admission or keep the space private.
